about.title: About ZaqaWork
about.lead: ZaqaWork is a job board for the Zaqatala, Balakan, Qakh and Shaki districts. Permanent, part-time and one-day work from local shops, restaurants, farms, schools and other employers, all in one place.
about.why: In the district, jobs are usually shared in Facebook groups and WhatsApp chats. They get lost quickly and cannot be searched. ZaqaWork brings them together: searchable, filterable and easy to read on a phone.
seekers: Search jobs by district, village, category and pay.
See the employer's phone on the job and call them directly.
Check “One-day jobs” for work that takes just a few hours.
employers: Sign up. A business name is optional, so private persons can post too.
Post a permanent, part-time or one-day job.
Jobs appear after admin review. Close the job once you have found a worker.
